title: VAT matrix list edit action route
purpose: Use the visible Page 472 More options / Liste bearbeiten action route to test whether the incomplete INLAND/VAT19 VAT Posting Setup row exposes true editors for VAT %, Sales VAT Account and Purchase VAT Account.

smartDecision.reason: D6 showed Page 472, the INLAND/VAT19 row, visible account columns and the menu item Liste bearbeiten. Microsoft Learn confirms the VAT Posting Setup must contain VAT rates and VAT G/L accounts. D3/D5 direct cell typing is rejected, so the next bounded execute case should enter the visible standard list-edit action first, then prove true editors before typing any value.
